quintin.reason: H = Upsilon(t-t_B) is Quintin's own single-field bounce ansatz; Hdot = Upsilon is constant across the NEC window, so a single field with constant kinetic normalisation has phidot^2 = 2 M_p^2 Upsilon = const: T -> inf in their profile.

LQC.reason: effective-fluid background (no matter Lagrangian is specified); a matter-sector phidot is not definable without adding one. The only geometry-fixed velocity is the total-sector phidot^2 = -2 M_p^2 Hdot, which vanishes at eta_B by the definition of the NEC boundary and is not Quintin's phidot.
